units.source_text: “嗯，是这样的：‘无论犯了什么罪行，导致他犯罪的动机一旦消失，那么就不能处分犯罪者了。’

en.t: Well, it is like this: 'No matter what crime he committed, once the motive that led him to commit it has disappeared, the offender can no longer be punished.'

units.source_text: 就你这事而言，那只河童以前有过儿子，但是现在他儿子已经死了，所以他所犯的罪也就一笔勾销了。”

en.t: As for your case, that kappa once had a son, but now his son is dead, so the crime he committed has been wiped out.
